name: Astellas Pharma Inc.
summary: Astellas Pharma Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and supply of pharmaceuticals in Japan and internationally. The company offers XTANDI, a treatment for prostate cancer; XOSPATA, a treatment for acute myeloid leukemia; VYLOY, a treatment for gastric adenocarcinoma and esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma; and PADCEV, a treatment for patients with metastatic urothelial carcinoma. It also provides VEOZAH, a treatment for vasomotor symptoms associated with menopause; IZERVAY, a treatment for age-related macular degeneration with geographic atrophy; Betanis/Myrabetriq/BETMIGA, a treatment for overactive bladder; and Prograf, an immunosuppressant.
